title: Evidence Gate evidence record
description: One JSON line of out/evidence.jsonl: the proof for one scenario run.

run_id.description: ID of the Gate run, for example r-20261105-101403.

criterion.description: Criterion ID, or null for an AI scenario not tied to a criterion.

confirmed.description: True when the expected value comes from the spec or a human. AI-proposed scenarios are never confirmed.

commit.description: Git commit the app was running.

action.description: Action name inside the adapter, for example quote_order.

input.description: Input values given to the action.

actual.description: What the driver saw, or null if it could not run.

status.description: pass or fail from the compare rule; error when the scenario could not run.

error.description: Error text, or null when it ran fine.

mismatches.description: Fields where expected and actual differ.

artifacts.description: Extra files, for example a screenshot path.

challenger.description: Which Challenger AI setup was used for this run.

model.description: Model name, or null when mode is off.

prompt_hash.description: Short hash of the prompt, or null when mode is off.
